Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
  checks,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await Future.wait(
        group.map((item) async {
          for (final check in checks) {
            // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
            await check(item);
          }
          return operation(item);
        }),
      ),
    );
  }
  return results;
}
